You are a young Anon living in a ghetto.
{{wc}}Once again you are left penniless after losing a job.

One night you see a military truck swerve and nearly crash{{punch=0.5,0.5}} in front of your apartment.
{{wc}}Some of its cargo falls out and into a nearby ditch, but the truck drives off.
